article.title: Trump EPA to strip greenhouse gas limits for power plants, a key Biden climate policy
article.author: Editor
article.content: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency will revoke limits on greenhouse gas emissions from power plants that run on coal and natural gas, according to regulatory documents Administrator Lee Zeldin signed Monday. The post Trump EPA to strip greenhouse gas limits for power plants, a key Biden climate policy appeared first on MR Online .
